_comment: Allowlist for the doc:check i18n identical-values warning. Each entry maps a key to the LANGUAGES in which its value is legitimately identical to the French one (cognate, brand name, emoji) — e.g. "catalog_title": ["en"] silences fr/en only, so a future Italian left as "Catalogue" STILL warns. Use "*" for a value identical in every language by nature (an emoji, a brand). This per-language shape replaced a flat key list, which silenced a key across all four pairs at once. Before adding a language to an entry, confirm the word really is the same in that language — that is the whole point of the warning.
_dynamic_comment: `dynamicKeyPrefixes` / `dynamicKeys` suppress the 'defined but never called as t("…")' UNUSED warning for keys that ARE live but are built dynamically (t(prefix+var), resolved via a map, or read as L.<key> property access in class components like EB). doc:check can only see literal t("key") + LANG[..]?.key, so these looked unused. Each prefix maps to a fixed data-driven family/enum (AROMA_WHEEL, DOCK_ITEMS, SHAPE_FAMILIES, *_FAMILIES, MAINT_KINDS/TASKS, the maturity bands, the plural-entity helpers, the autosave/EB/storage diagnostic groups). Keeping the list here means the unused warning goes back to ~0, so a genuinely-new dead key shows up again.
_dynamic_keys_comment: `lbl_deleted` / `lbl_updated` are the two verbs of the undo toast's overline, resolved through the UNDO_KIND table in Overlays.tsx (kind -> {kind, verb}) rather than called as literals. Listed here because `lbl_deleted` was passing gate 11 for the WRONG reason — `extractTKeys` matches inside COMMENTS, and the prose above that table quotes `t("lbl_deleted")`, so the key looked used purely because its name appears in an explanation. Same shape as the traps recorded for doc:check gate 15 / gridTracksCanShrink / topBannerInset, one gate over. Not fixed by stripping comments in `extractTKeys`: MEASURED, a naive stripper blanks a live `t("ai_scan_btn")` call in AICard.tsx, and gate 9 (a called key must exist in every dictionary) is an ERROR gate riding on the same extraction — weakening it to silence two warn-only lines is the wrong trade. Doing it properly needs a real tokeniser.
